entries.o: <fe><02><0a><38><32><34><61><5f><30><30><30><36><00>No matter. If he gets in my\nway, then I shall judge him.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><61><5f><30><30><35><38><00>You're my Familiar<fc><4a> you need to\nact like one sometimes.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><61><5f><30><30><36><38><00>Er, I figured you could get the\ntreasure without any problems...
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><61><5f><30><30><37><32><00>To think the day would come when\nyou worry about me...
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><61><5f><30><30><37><35><00>That is the last time I do\nsomething like that...
<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><34><38><00>No... I can feel power that\nsurpasses that of the Accursed.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><35><37><00>Ruler of the Underworld... and\nAsgard's greatest enemy.

<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><36><34><00>Prepare yourself, Ein!<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><36><35><00>Hades, King of the Underworld...\nYour sin is unforgivable.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><36><36><00>We shall pass judgment on you!\nIn the name of the Grim Angels!!
<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><37><32><00>His presence is gone. I'm not\nsure about his real body...
<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><37><37><00>The land of judgment... A special\nplace where Hades was sealed.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><37><38><00>That is my answer.

<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><37><39><00>And this is connected to\nRiviera underground...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><38><30><00>Is it pure coincidence?\nOr could it be...

<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><38><33><00>The vanquishing of Hades\ncaused a bend in space.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><38><34><00>This was originally a world\nisolated from ours...
<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><38><38><00>If Fate allows it, we\nshall meet again.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><38><39><00>Forget about this\nincident, Ein...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><39><30><00>We know too much about\nsomething we shouldn't...

<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><35><39><00>When I set foot in here, I felt\nthe distortion of air around us.<fe><00><fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><36><30><00>It's a similar feeling to when\nyou enter an isolated space.<fe><00><fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><36><31><00>You've felt it before.
<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><36><33><00>It's very close to that... Yet,\ncompletely different.
<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><36><35><00>It's too early to say.\nLet's investigate ahead.

<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><37><31><00>An isolated realm filled with
eternal darkness and madness...<fe><00><fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><37><32><00>Chaos... and the existence of
the Accursed...<fe><00><fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><37><33><00>I have concluded...<fe><00><fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><37><34><00>That this is the Underworld or
something equivalent to it.
<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><37><36><00>I have come to this conclusion\nfrom all the evidence present.
<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><39><32><00>The only gate that connects\nto the Underworld.

<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><39><34><00>But unlike Heaven's Gate,\nwhich is unchanging...<fe><00><fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><39><35><00>Chaos Gate is very unstable,\nmaking it a shifting existence.
<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><39><36><00>So the chances of seeing it\nare virtually zero...
<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><39><38><00>We're both Grim Angels, yet\nall this is news to me.

<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><31><30><30><00>The history of Asgard is deep\nbeyond imagination.<fe><00><fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><31><30><31><00>What I know is but a mere\nfraction of it.

<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><31><30><32><00>(Interesting...)<fe><00><fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><31><30><33><00>(It was molded over the course of
hundreds of thousands of years...)<fe><00><fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><31><30><34><00>(I'm getting more and more
interested in Asgard's history.)<fe><00><fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><31><30><35><00>(When we return there, I
wanna look that stuff up.)

<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><31><31><35><00>The King of the Underworld,\nenemy of the gods...<fe><00><fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><31><31><36><00>His existence is recorded in\nonly a handful of books...

<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><31><31><37><00>But he should be sealed\nby a powerful spell.<fe><00><fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><31><31><38><00>Even Grim Angels shouldn't\nbe able to go near him...

The world of chaos,
hidden deep beneath
Riviera. Here, the King
of the Underworld
reigns supreme.

The realm of chaos
where deep darkness
reigns. The hatred
of the sealed one
stirs throughout...
<fe><02><0a><74><30><30><30><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Ein, you haven't forgotten\nhow to fight, right?
<fe><02><0a><74><30><30><30><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Select an item and then\npress the © button, right?

<fe><02><0a><74><30><30><31><5f><30><30><30><30><00>The enemy is enraged about\ntheir fallen comrade.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><74><30><30><31><5f><30><30><30><31><00>They are weak, but don't\nlet your guard down.
<fe><02><0a><74><30><30><31><5f><30><30><32><35><00>Press the R button when\nyou're selecting an item.
<fe><02><0a><74><30><30><31><5f><30><30><32><36><00>You'll be able to see more\ninformation on it.

<fe><02><0c><74><30><30><32><5f><30><30><30><37><5f><61><00>It's your experience meter.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><74><30><30><32><5f><30><30><30><38><00>It increases every time you\nuse a Normal Skill.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><74><30><30><32><5f><30><30><30><39><00>When it's full, you'll learn\na new skill after the battle.
<fe><02><0a><74><30><30><32><5f><30><30><31><32><00>What happens if I run away?\n...Not that I would.
<fe><02><0a><74><30><30><32><5f><30><30><31><36><00>That's right. Now, get out\nthere and do it!
<fe><02><0a><74><30><30><32><5f><30><30><31><38><00>It's already full! But\nthe battle's not over yet.
<fe><02><0a><74><30><30><32><5f><30><30><32><30><00>It's about time you learn\nan Over Skill.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><74><30><30><32><5f><30><30><32><31><00>This battle is the perfect\nopportunity.
<fe><02><0a><74><30><30><32><5f><30><30><32><32><00>It's probably best to start\nwith your own weapon.

<fe><02><0a><74><30><31><30><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Holy guardian, my enemy\nis also yours.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><74><30><31><30><5f><30><30><30><31><00>With your burning wings,\nprotect the Promised Land!
<fe><02><0d><62><74><6c><5f><30><31><30><5f><30><30><30><31><00>In the name of the Grim\nAngels... I shall judge thee!
<fe><02><0d><62><74><6c><5f><30><31><30><5f><30><30><33><32><00>The cards never lie. Fortune\nhas dealt me the Hermit!
<fe><02><0d><62><74><6c><5f><30><31><31><5f><30><30><31><34><00>(Men like a woman who can\ncook... I better practice!)
<fe><02><0d><62><74><6c><5f><30><31><31><5f><30><30><33><36><00>I have no choice but to\nturn to the dark side...
<fe><02><0d><62><74><6c><5f><30><31><31><5f><30><30><34><31><00>O magic of lightning sealed\nwithin the gem...
<fe><02><0d><62><74><6c><5f><30><31><32><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Can't stand the heat? Then\nstay outta the kitchen!
<fe><02><0d><62><74><6c><5f><30><31><32><5f><30><30><31><31><00>I hope this doesn't come\nback to haunt me! <fc><4b>chomp<fc><4b>
<fe><02><0d><62><74><6c><5f><30><31><33><5f><30><30><34><33><00>CoCo bakes the best bread\nin all of Elendia.
<fe><02><0d><62><74><6c><5f><30><31><34><5f><30><30><31><38><00>Grind and mix... Then add\na Healing Herb and stir...
<fe><02><0d><62><74><6c><5f><30><31><34><5f><30><30><33><30><00>Now is the time to unleash\nthe sacred power within!
<fe><02><0d><62><74><6c><5f><30><31><34><5f><30><30><34><34><00>The cards have spoken...\nJustice shall be served!
<fe><02><0d><62><74><6c><5f><30><31><34><5f><30><30><34><37><00>Let our wounds be healed and\nour magic be strengthened!
<fe><02><0d><62><74><6c><5f><30><31><34><5f><30><30><34><38><00>It's rather heavy, but it\nwill serve its purpose!
<fe><02><0d><62><74><6c><5f><30><31><35><5f><30><30><30><34><00>Burn in the crimson flames\nof judgment... Lost Seraph!
<fe><02><0d><62><74><6c><5f><30><32><30><5f><30><30><31><33><00>I guess it's our fate to\npass judgment on demons...
<fe><02><0d><62><74><6c><5f><30><32><31><5f><30><30><30><39><00>They don't call me the\nScarlet Witch for nothing<a2><43>
<fe><02><0d><62><74><6c><5f><30><32><32><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Why are you attacking ME!?\nThe enemy's over there!
<fe><02><0a><74><30><31><34><5f><30><30><30><33><00>I want to tell you about the\n¤Position Change¤ command.

<fe><02><0a><74><30><31><34><5f><30><30><30><35><00>During battle, you can\nchange formation.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><74><30><31><34><5f><30><30><30><36><00>Rotating clockwise, swapping\nfront and back lines...
<fe><02><0a><74><30><31><34><5f><30><30><31><32><00>How many times can I use\nthe Position Shift?
<fe><02><0a><74><30><31><34><5f><30><30><31><38><00>Try it a few times\nand you'll catch on.
<fe><02><0a><74><30><31><38><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Hey, is there some trick\nto winning battles?

<fe><02><0a><74><30><31><38><5f><30><30><30><36><00>When you select a skill,
a window appears.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><74><30><31><38><5f><30><30><30><37><00>Toward the top of that
window, there's a bar.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><74><30><31><38><5f><30><30><30><38><00>Use the length of the bar
to estimate your damage.
<fe><02><0a><74><30><31><38><5f><30><30><30><39><00>So the longer the bar...\nthe more powerful the skill?

<fe><02><0a><74><30><31><38><5f><30><30><31><32><00>That's one strategy.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><74><30><31><38><5f><30><30><31><33><00>But skills have other
attributes. For example...<fe><00><fe><02><0c><74><30><31><38><5f><30><30><31><34><5f><61><00>Some put the enemy to sleep
and some absorb HP.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><74><30><31><38><5f><30><30><31><35><00>It's smart to consider
these effects as well.
<fe><02><0a><74><30><31><38><5f><30><30><31><36><00>How can you tell if\nthere are added effects?
<fe><02><0a><74><30><31><38><5f><30><30><31><37><00>Press the R button when\nselecting a skill.
<fe><02><0a><74><30><39><34><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Despair! Your soul\nis as good as mine!
<fe><02><0a><74><30><39><38><5f><30><30><30><33><00>Come, show me the desperate\nbrilliance of your souls!
The Hell Hound is weak against fire,\nso Ledah's attacks should come in handy.\nThis battle shouldn't be a problem.
Devastator, the Gremlin's Max attack,\ncuts everyone's HP in half. Getting hit\nearly on will make things difficult.
The Berserker's attacks are not very\naccurate, but do a great deal of damage.\nHe targets characters from a distance.
Be careful of the Arachne's web attacks.\nOn top of doing damage, they add counts\nto your WAIT meter.
The Rabid Beast has a lot of HP, but,\nlike most beasts, is weak against fire.\nLedah should be able to handle it.
Lilith usually strikes only one target,\nbut her Rage and Max attacks will hit\nthe entire front line, so watch out!
High HP and fire resistance make it\na troublesome foe. It'd be nice to have\na Dragon Killer for this battle.
Lilith's Max attack, Dark Grip, heals\nher allies while damaging her enemy.\nIt's double the trouble, so be careful.
What you get after battle depends on your\nrank and who you defeat last. You'll get\na Naga Fang for defeating the Naga.
A strong pair, but because they are so\nclose together, Ledah's pierce attacks\ncan damage both at once.
Aghart primarily uses fire attacks.\nIf you have one, you should use a Fire\nOrb to raise your fire resistance.
When Big Bear's HP gets low, his Brutal\nOnslaught becomes more powerful. Don't\never let your guard down!
The Triffid has high HP but low VIT, so\nit takes a lot of damage. There's only\none, so constantly attacking will work.
The Evil Mage summons the Undead\nsometimes, so defeat him first. Using\nSlumber Ivy is a nice option.
The Viper Rachet's Max, Bullet Dive,\nforces your front and back lines\nto switch, so be careful!
The Gladiator's Shield raises the front\nrow's guard percentage while\nthe Evil Mage attacks with magic.
The Green Slime's Rage attack, Acidic\nSolution, is an annoying move that\nlowers an item's endurance.
The Luna Vampire is the main member\nof this team. The Misery use Quick to\nshorten the front line's wait time.
The Murmur's Max, Explosion, is an\nultra-powerful, all-range kamikaze\nattack.
If there's a space, the Evil Mage will\nsummon an Undead demon, so it's a good\nidea to defeat him first.
The Triffid's Tentacle Attack has the\nability to absorb HP. The Bogie's main\ntarget is the front row.
The Bogie in the front attacks nearby\nwhile the Tiny Thief attacks far, so\nthe right side is the safest area.
Protected in a special barrier,\nall attacks will be voided.\nWhat can you do...?
The Tiny Thief and the Gladiator both\nattack nearby, so put two people up in\nthe front to draw their attacks.
The Luna Vampire in the back line has\na move that deals damage while\nrecovering HP.
HP is unknown. She is powerful, but you\ncan deal damage with fire attacks. Ice\nattacks do no damage whatsoever.
The knight can easily resist all\nphysical attacks. He has low MGC, so\nmagic attacks can deal major damage.
The Black Wyrm's Gale will blow you\nout of battle and back to the field.\nDon't let it reach Max mode.
The S. Thor Wisp is weak against fire\nattacks, so use the Flamberg to deal\nmajor damage.
The S. Diamond Dust is weak against\nlightning attacks, so use the Thunder\nBow to deal major damage.
The S. Nightmare is weak against holy\nattacks, so use the Silver Rapier to\ndeal major damage.
The Luna Vampire summons a familiar from\ntime to time, so don't let up. Pummel\nher with her weakness: holy attacks.
The Hedge Spider in the back can add to\nyour WAIT meter, so it is best to defeat\nit first or put it to sleep.
The Skeleton has several poison moves.\nWhen poisoned, your HP will slowly\ndecrease, so pay attention to your HP.
The S. Nightmare is weak against holy\nattacks, so attack with moves like\nthe Einherjar's Slash.
It's only one Misery, so you should have\nno problem winning. Just fight\nhowever you're most comfortable.
The Gust can steal items from you with\nits skill, Snatch. The stolen item\ncan't be used in battle.
The Banshee in the back uses fire magic\nto attack distant characters, so put a\ncharacter with high MGC in the back.
The enemy team is well-balanced. It's\nbest to utilize the targeting system and\nfocus on defeating one enemy at a time.
Its Rage move, Talon Drop, targets\nthe character with the highest\nremaining HP and halves it.
Lina and Fia's Bow Over Skills deal\nmajor damage to flying enemies. Check\nthe target and aim for the Harpuia.
The Giant Beetle is strong against\nphysical attacks, so attack with another\nproperty, preferably lightning.
The Wyrm in the back is very strong, and\nshould be attacked with anti-air moves\nor a Dragon Killer.
The Aeon Ape's Rage move, Angry Fist, gets\nstronger as he loses HP. On top of that,\nit scrambles your formation.
Use piercing moves, such as Ein\nand Serene's Rapier Over Skills, to pierce\nthrough defenses and fight efficiently.
In Rage mode, it will use a powerful ice\nor dark attack. Raise resistance\nto those properties and heal often.
Undead enemies have 0 VIT, so weak,\nmultiple-hit attacks are effective.\nThey're also weak against holy attacks.
The Mantrap's Rage move, Sleep Pollen,\nhas a strong sleep effect, so watch out\nfor that!
Anti-air moves are the best choice, but\nfire and ice attacks can also deal a\nfair amount of damage.
The Pelga's Max move, Cyclone Fury,\nis powerful. But there's only one, so\nthat shouldn't be a big problem.
Using the Acid Jellies' weakness, ice,\ndefeat them quickly before they lower\nyour items' endurance!
Fight normally, but be careful of\nIcicle Shower, its Max move which \nignores VIT stats and can freeze you!
It's only a single Aeon Ape. Just watch\nfor its Rage move, Angry Fist--it\nreverses your formation.
They are actually quite powerful. It is\nbest to plan your attacks and defeat them\none by one, slowly but surely.
Since the Mercury Ooze can lower your\nitems' endurance, it may be wise to take\nless important items into battle.
The Chariot's Max attack, Icicle Shower,\ndeals damage regardless of the target's\nvitality, so be prepared.
The Vile Raven's Max attack,\nCyclone Fury, deals a random number\nof hits, so be careful.
The Chariot's attacks all deal damage\nregardless of the target's VIT, and its\nRage move, Stone Beam, can petrify you.
The Elder Wyrm's Max attack, Gale Wing,\nwill blow you right out of battle. Be sure\nto avoid using multiple-hit techniques!
The Fool normally attacks with physical\nattacks, but his Rage move is an ice attack,\nand his Max move is a dark attack.
The Strong Guard will attack using\nthe same property he is attacked with.\nBe careful of what attacks you use!
A powerful foe, but all its attacks other\nthan its Max attack won't hit the back\nline, so move the weak to the rear.
The Firbolg is very strong, and tough\nagainst physical attacks, so use attacks\nwith elemental properties.
This team has no real weaknesses. They\ntend to focus on a single target, so it\nmay be wise to alter your formation often.
They're not very good with magic, so magic\nattacks work well. The beast-type enemies\nin the front line are susceptible to fire.
The Sage normally attacks with physical\nattacks, but her Rage move is a fire attack,\nand her Max move is a lightning attack.
Her elemental attacks are quite\npowerful, so be aware of your\ncharacters' weaknesses.
Although she has high MGC, she has low\nSTR, so physical attacks are effective.\nCharacters susceptible to magic beware!
They're not difficult opponents. Just use\nattacks that are effective against flying\nenemies, and settle things quickly.
The Strong Guard can raise the front\nline's guard percentage using Shield.\nIf you have an unblockable move, use it.
The Devil Imp is the one to watch out\nfor. It's not very strong, so pound it\nwith physical attacks.
When they are in Rage mode, they target\nthe character with the lowest HP,\nso keep an eye on your party's health.
It's only a single Devil Imp,\nso you should have no trouble\nwinning this battle.
The Stone Golem is strong and sturdy.\nYou should put characters with high STR\nand VIT in the front line.
Without the Firbolg, they are much easier.\nJust make sure the front line characters\nhave high STR and the back line high MGC.
The Necromancer in the back summons\nundead enemies, so use long-range\nattacks to defeat him first.
The Unknown Material's Max move,\nSplatter Bomb, damages everyone\nregardless of their VIT.
The Balrog in the front will summon\na familiar, and the Pyrallis will use\nQuick to speed up the others.
The Carnage Sect uses webbing to\nslow you down, while the enemies\nin the front line attack.
There's only one, but it has incredibly\nhigh HP. Keep chipping away at its HP\nusing holy attacks.
The Stone Golem attacks at close range,\nwhile the Pyrallis uses magic to hit the\nrear. Set your formation accordingly.
The Skull Fencer uses its Max attack,\nMortem Dance, to absorb its target's HP.\nDon't give it the chance!
The Flare Phantom goes after\nthe character with the lowest HP,\nso be sure to heal often.
The Lunatic Maiden and Necromancer both\nuse powerful magic to attack characters\nin the back line. Be ready!
Both the Balrog and the Saber Wolf\nattack the front line when in Rage mode.\nThe 1-2 formation works well.
All three foes can lower your items'\nendurance. It's best not to bring any\nimportant items into this battle.
Death is strong both physically and\nmagically, so be prepared. Holy attacks\nwill be the most effective against him.
It has high STR and MGC, but it is weak\nagainst holy attacks. Weapons designed\nfor dragon fighting are also effective.
The Basilisk has high VIT, so a single,\npowerful hit is better than several small ones.\nUse moves that are unaffected by VIT.
When an Elemental uses Change, that's\nyour chance. Try to find its weakness,\nand attack using that property.
It's just a Savage Ogre, so there's\nno excuse for losing. Just fight\nnormally.
The Carnivine has high HP, but is\nweak against fire, so be aggresive\nwith fire attacks.
Since the Carnage Sect targets\ncharacters in the front line,\nthe 1-2 formation may be optimal.
Note your enemy's attack types.\nIf there's a property a character is\nweak against, raise his/her resistance.
The Lich's Max attack, Biting Frost,\nis a powerful magic attack with ice\nproperties that hits everyone.
The Skull Fencer has several moves that\nhave the property of darkness, so place\nthose with low resistance in the back.
All of the Belial Queen's moves have\ndark properties. Place characters weak\nto dark in the back line.
